name: @nandomo/bridge-qml
description: QML bridge for nandomo: primitives (View/Button/Text/Input/Container/Image) returning SpecNode, plus render() that emits a Qt6 QML file and spawns `qml app.qml` (single-process, V4 JS engine). JSX runtime supports @Component class composition identical to bridge-web. Storage capability backed by an in-memory store (QSettings is wired through a stub for MVP — QSettings requires a QCoreApplication; see capabilities.ts).
